[{"id": "nnvMTG5Sl5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83c\udf0dMissions Manual", "col": 12}}, {"id": "B-CtTCmVDX", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The missions module contains features related to missions outreach of the church.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "w8oEjl0tNc", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udce3Missionaries", "col": 12}}, {"id": "6IlcMu_Ikb", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Missionaries that the church supports.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "0J08Yp0qsz", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When adding a new missionary, note the following. The form has the tabs Details, Contact, Support, Letters and Notes, and Connections.
- Details: set the 'Status': Active, Pending or Inactive. A new missionary starts as Active. Inactive missionaries are left out of the Church Directory, the Missions page of the website and its map, and are never picked as a bulletin's Missionary of the Week. The Missions page shows the map only when it lists at least one missionary. A missionary without a photo has a shorter card, with the name, agency and country. If needed, you can create more missionary statuses. Two missionaries of one church cannot have the same Title.
- If applicable, link an associated Missionary Agency. This can be used to group missionaries in reports or on the missions webpage.
- Tick 'Publish' to show the missionary on the public website. Tick 'Sensitive' for a missionary in a closed country: the website and the missions map leave them out even when Publish is ticked, bulletins leave them out unless Bulletin Settings includes sensitive missionaries, and the Church Directory hides their country and contact details.
- Adding a photo is recommended. The Missions page of the website shows the photo on the missionary's card and on their pin on the map. Without a photo, the card shows only the name, the agency, the country and the website.
- List the People the missionary record is about in the 'People' table, such as a couple and their children, or the contact person at a supported organization or ministry. When the Church Directory includes missionaries, these people are listed under the missionary in its missionaries section, and not on the family pages. To list a whole household at once, click 'Add Family' under the People table and pick the Family: everyone in it who is not listed yet is added.
- The 'Location' section holds the pin on the missions map. It stays closed: click 'Location' to open it. Choosing a country places the pin, and you can drag it to the exact place.
- Contact: the 'Emails', 'Phone Numbers' and 'Addresses' tables work as on a Person. The 'Emails' and 'Addresses' tables show 'Bounced' and 'Returned' when email or mail sent there came back. Tick 'Mailing' on the address that gets mail from the church.
- Support: the Support Amount and Support Frequency that the church gives, and the start and end dates. The Support End Date cannot be before the Support Start Date. Tick 'Auto-create Expenses' and choose an Expense Type to get a draft Expense for each support period, which staff review and submit. The drafts for the periods since the support start date appear within a minute after you save.
- Letters and Notes: prayer letters (or other letters) go in the 'Letters to the Church' table. It shows the Date Received, the File, Private and Share With Church. Share With Church and Shared Date are hidden while Private is ticked. Click the pencil icon at the end of a row to type the letter's text or fill in the Shared Date. Prayer letters may be displayed on the missions webpage in future versions. Other documents can be linked to the Missionary in the 'Related Documents' table (i.e. People, Events, Collections, etc). The 'Notes' box is under the tables.
- Connections: the Bulletins that featured the missionary, and for finance users the Expenses paid to them.

The Missionaries list is in name order. It shows the Status (Active green, Pending orange, Inactive gray), the Agency, the Country, the Support Amount and the Support Frequency. The Missions workspace shows the number of current missionaries and of agencies, a chart of missionaries by status and the Missionary Map. The Current Missionaries card counts the missionaries whose status is not Inactive, so Pending missionaries count too. Click it to open the Current Missionaries list. The sidebar lists Missionaries, Missionary Agencies, Missionary Letters and Letters Not Yet Read. Letters Not Yet Read shows the letters that have Share With Church ticked and no Shared Date. Missionary Statuses and Support Frequencies are in Setup.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "8zFlGyC4XI", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83c\udfe2Missionary Agencies", "col": 12}}, {"id": "kDsKUF3xl2", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Missionary Agencies are often used by Missionaries for support & guidance.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "t5oHSN8It-", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When adding a missionary agency, note the following:
- It is recommended to add the agency logo since this may be displayed on the public facing missions webpage.
- The Missionary Agencies list is in name order. Point at an agency on a Missionary form to see its website and notes.", "col": 12}}]
